description: Bounded Phase 6 smoke check (plugin-lifecycle-upstream) -- confirms the skill loads and activates correctly on a representative trigger phrase without crashing the harness. Not exhaustive per-trigger-phrase testing.

evals.name: Activates and follows Phase 1 correctly on a representative full-retrospective request
evals.prompt: run a full retrospective and consolidate the findings, then fix what it finds
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this as a multi-analysis consolidation request, ask (via a described AskUserQuestion-style choice) which analysis types to run with multiSelect framing, and ask for scope once -- not per analysis type. Should NOT immediately dispatch anything or skip the picker.
